title: Pear and clementine crumble with hazelnuts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Pears, clementines, honey, butter, ground almonds, demerara, hazelnuts and Greek yoghurt are all ordinary kitchen foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is on the shelves of any Tesco, and ground almonds and hazelnuts are normal baking-aisle buys at these amounts.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a bowl, a knife and an oven, and rubbing in is a beginner's technique.

works.reason: Four pears and six clementines under a 60g butter, 100g almond crumble at 190°C for 25 to 30 minutes gives a sensible warm snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Coring four pears, peeling and slicing six clementines, rubbing in and chopping hazelnuts fits about 15 minutes, and the 30-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon appear in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm fruit crumble suits early December, and clementines are a main part of the fruit base rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, British and easy to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fruit, nuts and yoghurt with modest sugar make a proper snack a family would happily eat again.
